rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion narrow and institutional, drawing the administrable line that jurisdiction persists only for post-award motions filed in the same stayed case that had original jurisdiction at the outset, preserving Badgerow for standalone applications. Barrett and Gorsuch are the most plausible alternative authors given their text-focused “pending suit” framing, while Jackson is the most likely dissenter to write to police anti-bootstrapping limits.
